summary: DoorDash has apologized for supporting a GOP bill targeting D.C., while the ACLU raises concerns about National Guard troops in the District. A senator has committed to making D.C. statehood a top priority, and advocacy groups have marked the anniversary of a federal deployment of National Guard troops to D.C., arguing it underscores the need for statehood. Without statehood, the District's National Guard answers to the President, not to the officials D.C. residents elect.
